accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure Gold text is only used on Dark backgrounds or is dark enough (#B4941F) on white.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Outfit' font for all headings to give a premium modern feel.
Use 'DM Sans' for body text for high readability.
Implement the 'Gold' accent sparingly - mostly for borders, small icons, or text gradients. Do not make big gold buttons (use Navy for primary actions).
The Chatbot Demo on the landing page must be interactive. Use a 'fake' conversation flow if backend is not ready, or connect to the real API.
Dashboard should be clean and white. Use the Navy color for the Sidebar.
Use the provided Unsplash images for the respective sections.
Ensure the 'Scoring' visualization (Hot/Warm/Cold) uses intuitive colors: Fire/Red for Hot, Yellow for Warm, Blue/Ice for Cold.
For the 'Pricing' section, highlight the 'Premium' plan with a Gold border or shadow.
Create a 'Layout' component that handles the Navbar and Footer.
Use 'framer-motion' for subtle entrance animations if possible, otherwise standard CSS transitions.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for dark colors.
Avoid generic centered layouts; use asymmetry where possible.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
